players.name: Cal Raleigh
players.summary: Raleigh is mired in a 0-for-29 slump over his last 7 games, with his batting average plummeting. The Mariners dropped him in the batting order and have used him at DH while monitoring right-side tightness. He says he is 'searching for answers.'

sources.title: Cal Raleigh searching for answers during slump: 'It's been really ugly'

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Harper exited Saturday's game (May 9 vs. Colorado) in the 1st inning with a sudden migraine. He was expected to return for Sunday's finale and the Phillies had an off day Monday. Not currently on the injured list.

sources.title: Bryce Harper departs Saturday's Phillies game with migraine

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Arraez went 2-for-4 with 2 runs scored as the Giants dismantled the Dodgers 9-3 to open a four-game series at LA. He had a key hit in the 7th-inning rally when San Francisco broke a 3-3 tie with a 5-run inning. Batting .315 on the season.

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Scouts believe Bichette is not fully healthy, likely still nursing a PCL sprain from last September. His sprint speed is measurably down. With Francisco Lindor and Ronny Mauricio both injured, Bichette may shift back to shortstop.

sources.title: Scouts Believe Mets' Bo Bichette is Not Fully Healthy

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Kevin McGonigle (DET) continues to put together one of the best rookie seasons in Tigers history, leading AL rookies in hits, doubles, and batting average. Detroit opens a 3-game road series at Citi Field starting Tuesday, May 12.

sources.title: Kevin McGonigle's first-month performance review with Tigers: Historically high marks

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: PCA and the Cubs had an off day Monday before a 3-game road series at Atlanta starting Tuesday. Chicago was shut out twice in its most recent series vs. Texas, raising concerns about the offense.

sources.title: Enhanced Box Score: Rangers 3, Cubs 0 - May 10, 2026

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Merrill and the Padres split their 4-game home series with St. Louis and have an off day Monday. In Sunday's dramatic extra-innings win, Merrill was intentionally walked in the 10th to load the bases and set up San Diego's walk-off victory.

sources.title: Padres rally to beat Cardinals in extra innings, splitting series

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Manager Dave Roberts gave Hernández a planned rest day Monday as the Dodgers hosted the Giants (who won 9-3). He has a .614 OPS in May with no HR since April 15. Roberts hinted Alex Call could get more starts in left field.

sources.title: Dave Roberts suggests potential change is coming with Teoscar Hernández

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: Ben Rice crushed his 13th homer of the season — a 374-foot 2-run blast to left-center off Baltimore's Brandon Young in the 3rd inning — but the Yankees fell 3-2 to the Orioles. Rice and Aaron Judge became the first Yankees duo with 13+ HRs each in the team's first 42 games.

sources.title: Yankees' Ben Rice unlocks historic feat with Aaron Judge after huge HR vs. Orioles

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams has turned the corner after a rocky April, stringing together 6 consecutive scoreless outings and converting 5 saves. His ERA has dropped from a peak of 10.29 to around 6.0. The Mets are cautiously optimistic his signature changeup is returning to form.

sources.title: Devin Williams Starting to Turn the Corner - Metsmerized Online

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Wheeler has made 3 solid starts (1-0, 3.11 ERA, 18 K in 17.1 IP) since returning from thoracic outlet syndrome surgery. The Phillies are managing his workload carefully as he rebuilds arm strength. They had a scheduled off day Monday.

sources.title: Zack Wheeler 2026 Game by Game Pitching Logs

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Ragans was placed on the 15-day IL (retroactive to May 7) with left elbow impingement (valgus extension overload, pitcher's elbow). He exited his May 6 start vs. Cleveland after 3 innings with tricep and elbow soreness. The Royals have not given a return timeline.

sources.title: Royals Place Cole Ragans On IL With Elbow Impingement - MLB Trade Rumors

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Burns has been outstanding for Cincinnati, posting a 2.21 ERA over 41.2 IP in 7 starts and leading the NL in pitching WAR. The Reds had a scheduled off day Monday; Burns is expected to start Tuesday vs. Washington.

sources.title: Chase Burns, your National League leader in pitching WAR

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Eovaldi was scratched from Monday's start vs. Arizona due to left side tightness — he woke up with discomfort and had imaging done before first pitch. The Rangers are awaiting results to determine severity. Oblique injuries can often lead to extended absences.

sources.title: Eovaldi scratched with left side tightness; Rangers turn to bullpen

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Sheehan was not in Monday's rotation as Roki Sasaki started for the Dodgers in a 9-3 loss to San Francisco. Sheehan (2-2, 5.22 ERA) is projected to start later this week on the road in St. Louis.

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Detmers was not scheduled for Monday's start as Brent Suter took the mound for the Angels in a 7-2 loss to Cleveland. Detmers (1-2, 4.28 ERA) will look to bounce back in his next scheduled outing.

injuries.name: Cole Ragans
injuries.note: Pitcher's elbow (VEO); placed May 8 retroactive to May 7; return timeline TBD

source.title: Royals Place Cole Ragans On IL With Elbow Impingement

injuries.name: Nathan Eovaldi
injuries.note: Late scratch May 11 vs. Arizona; underwent imaging; results pending; possible IL move

source.title: Eovaldi scratched with left side tightness; Rangers turn to bullpen
